worldcombat.skill.irontail.summary: Raise the steel tail and light up a locked line as a warning, then slam it down onto the point: everyone in the ring takes a heavy hit and is shoved, and a solid slam may dent the armour for a Defence drop of one stage or more. The heaviest and slowest of the guard-breakers, and the one a foe can walk out of.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.description.0: The slam lands on the locked point; every enemy inside its ring takes %1$s contact damage and is shoved %2$s blocks away from the point.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.description.1: The tail reaches %1$s blocks with a %2$s block impact radius; a foe that steps out of the ring during the raise dodges the slam.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.description.2: A solid hit has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Defence by %2$s stage and leave a dented mark for %3$s; the mark itself changes no stats, but other guard-breaking moves use it to press Defence down further.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.description.3: The raise to the drop takes %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.growth.0: From level %1$s the slam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.growth.1: From level %1$s a dent lowers Defence by %2$s stage.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.growth.2: From level %1$s the slam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.irontail.use.0: Make the raise itself the pressure
worldcombat.skill.irontail.use.1: Slam a target and its landing apart
worldcombat.skill.irontail.use.2: Dent a hard target's guard deeper
worldcombat.skill.irontail.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of raising the tail. Larger values start from further out and get walked out of the ring more often.
On: prefer targets that are not dented yet and are above half health. Off: treat it as an ordinary close attack.
